name: The Shortall household at 1604 Prairie Avenue
head: pa1904_shortall_john_l

present_on_scene_date.note: Listed at 1604 Prairie Avenue in the Blue Book for 1904 (canvass begun September 1903); the 1905 edition (canvass begun September 1904) prints 1604 Rev. & Mrs. Wm. Otis Waters. The household left within that year, and whether it was still in the house on 1 July 1904 is not documented.

associated_with.note: The Blue Book's Prairie Avenue street list prints the household at 1604. The book gives no date the household came or went, so neither end is dated here.

not_in_this_household.note: WHO IS NOT ON THIS CARD, AND WHY. The Blue Book is a society register: it names the family members who received and were received, prints unmarried daughters only as '& dr.', and names no young children, servants, coachmen, cooks or nurses. The 1900 census (ED 36, T623 roll 245) was read for this card. The two live-in staff and four children it lists at the house on 1 June 1900 are on the card, graded inferred because the count was taken four years before the scene. The 1910 census was not read. A person goes on this card when a source names them, and not before.

persons.name: John L. Shortall
persons.note: The 1900 census lists John L. Shortall here as head, born May 1865, in Illinois, married, lawyer (ED 36, sheet 3A, line 9, leaf n669).

born.note: The existing census transcription gives born May 1865. The year is carried into the age shown on this card.
